notes:
The card's family-config decision and GymnasiumDriver express the real interface: the registered LocoMujoco environment is a gymnasium.Env, so the bridge derives cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 from its spaces and from dt; no native.py and no x-cap extension was needed. The driver binds env_id LocoMujoco with env_name Atlas and pins timestep 0.001 s and n_substeps 10, the LocoEnv constructor defaults (environments/base.py:51-52), so the control step is 10 ms (mujoco_base.py:1307-1314 with n_intermediate_steps 1 at :125 and no simulation-frequency control at control_functions/base.py:96-100). The fake backend is this package's pure Python placeholder that duck-types GymnasiumWrapper reset/step/close (fake.py); it returns 68 placeholder observation values (the 65 Atlas default observation entries plus the 3 GoalRandomRootVelocity goal values) and accepts 27 action values in [-1, 1]. Those widths and values are test data, not device facts. The upstream sim backend (gymnasium.make with loco_mujoco, jax, mujoco and the separate loco_mujoco_models model files) was not installed or run, so NOT COVERED: the upstream MuJoCo simulation path and its real observation vector; only the fake surface was checked. Expected warnings, kept: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only sets the seed of the next reset and makes no native call) and G8.NO_UNIT x4 for the bridge-derived inputs seed twice, ticks and action.values[*] (the family bridge derives these schemas; declaring actions to add units was not attempted because it exposes the reset inputs without descriptions, as in the exemplar). No hardware was attached and no hardware run is claimed; the package is model-authored, driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null, and the evidence is contract_checked on the fake backend.
